title: Portfolio Performance Quote Weekly Day Change Percent Trend
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=portfolio:quote day_change_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(day_change_pct) as avg_duration, max(day_change_pct) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst day change percent for Portfolio Performance quote events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture day_change_pct on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average day change percent with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It will warn whether Portfolio Performance quote tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
